task.title: Random ring course
task.goal: Take off, then fly through 5 rings in order. Each ring is a vertical circle of 60 m radius, passed by flying through it in its heading. The course changes with the seed. No landing needed. The aircraft is a quadcopter drone: it takes off and lands vertically, hovers in place and flies forward at up to 45 kt.

result.reason: time budget of 900 s of simulated time reached
